if grep -q 'temporary host-certificate verification key' /root/.ssh/authorized_keys; then exit 1; fi
for f in /root/.ssh/host-cert-test-key /root/.ssh/host-cert-test-key.pub /root/.ssh/host-ca-known_hosts; do if [ -e "$f" ]; then exit 1; fi; done
printf '%s\n' 'temporary_client_credentials=removed'
ssh-keyscan -c -T 5 -t ed25519 "$NODE_IP" 2>/dev/null > /tmp/served-host-cert.pub
printf 'served_certificate_lines='; wc -l < /tmp/served-host-cert.pub
ssh-keygen -L -f /tmp/served-host-cert.pub | grep -E 'Type:|Signing CA:|Key ID:|node1|10.100.199.10'
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'ssh_service='; systemctl is-active ssh
rm -f /tmp/served-host-cert.pub
stdout:
temporary_client_credentials=removed
served_certificate_lines=1
        Type: ssh-ed25519-cert-v01@openssh.com host certificate
        Signing CA: ED25519 SHA256:QCoOTSYD2z5PO9ILYlUJLhryyWm7vZmXSBx41WI3OV0 (using ssh-ed25519)
        Key ID: "node1-host-20261002"
                node1
                10.100.199.10
boot_id=48d8caa0-db81-4d39-8331-8f19475fd9dd
ssh_service=active
